segments.normalizedSource: ```swift extension FixedWidthInteger { var binaryString: String { var result: [String] = [] for i in 0..<(Self.bitWidth / 8) { let byte = UInt8(truncatingIfNeeded: self >> (i * 8)) let byteString = String(byte, radix: 2) let padding = String(repeating: "0", count: 8 - byteString.count) result.append(padding + byteString) } return "0b" + result.reversed().joined(separator: "_") } } print(Int16.max.binaryString) // Prints "0b01111111_11111111" print((101 as UInt8).binaryString) // Prints "0b01100101" ```
